title: Writing Knowledge-Base Entries from Cited Papers, Scored on Curators' Per-Paper Facts

addressed_weaknesses.weakness: v0 W1: no human validation; one model family makes every judgement
addressed_weaknesses.status: acknowledged; cannot be fixed with existing data
addressed_weaknesses.change: Limitation (i) first: no person validated any judgement; says what expert labels on a stratified sample with chance-corrected agreement would establish and that 95.7% agreement between two judgings is self-consistency only; a manual check of not-stated facts would show how much of that contrast is mechanical. Experiments intro and contributions state that no person validated the judgements.
addressed_weaknesses.evidence: log 4.1 (3498 of 3654, 95.7%); log 12; notes 'Not done, and not to be promised'

addressed_weaknesses.weakness: v0 W2: stated/not-stated contrast partly mechanical
addressed_weaknesses.change: Access claim is led by the hidden-full-text experiment in abstract, introduction and Sec. 4.1. Where the split is shown, one sentence says it agrees with that result but holds partly by construction because 'stated' needs a quote the model found. Fig. 2(b,c), Fig. 3 restrictions and the appendix table are labelled post hoc.

addressed_weaknesses.weakness: v0 W3: unmatched settings in the headline comparison; claims inconsistent with the matched ablation
addressed_weaknesses.status: addressed by rewriting and rescoping (matched run on all 93 entries not available)
addressed_weaknesses.change: Sec. 3.2 states in the main text that per-paper extraction ran at medium effort and synopsis terms (and the case table's inheritance) were assigned by rule in the main comparison. 'No design conveyed more than direct reading' is kept only 'at the main settings'. New post hoc paragraph 'Settings and entry sets' in Sec. 4.2: on the 38 ablation entries the evidence graph was already +1.0 (-0.9 to +2.8) and the case table -2.3 at the main settings; matching moved the case table +2.1 (+1.1 to +3.2; 25/8) and the graph only +0.8 (-0.5 to +2.1); the graph's sign is -1.2 / +3.1 on the two halves of the ablation entries. Supported claim used everywhere: designs differ by a few points either way, which is ahead depends on the entries compared and, for the case table, on settings, every such difference small against the 43.7 points full text adds. Table 1 holds the main comparison only; new Appendix Table (tab:app_abl_main) puts the main-settings rows of the same 38 entries beside the matched rows. Nothing about the matched evidence graph appears in abstract or introduction.
addressed_weaknesses.evidence: log 1.2; log 5 (means, steps, each-strategy-vs-direct, 'The ablation set and the main comparison'); notes 'What the ablation shows' and 'Scope the strategy claim'

addressed_weaknesses.weakness: v0 W4: tested regime favours direct reading; many-relevant-papers regime untested
addressed_weaknesses.status: acknowledged; cannot be fixed with existing data
addressed_weaknesses.change: Discussion states the regime (most papers abstracts; 2,669 of 6,239 facts not stated; stated full-text facts on 40 entries). Limitation (iii) rewritten per notes: size tested only by padding with unrelated text; large sets of relevant papers could not be compared because of stopped replies; matched settings on 38 entries; one implementation per paradigm. Large-entry and padding runs reduced to one sentence each (Sec. 4.4) with details in Appendix K.
addressed_weaknesses.evidence: log 2.10a; log 14.1; log 14.2; notes 'Limitations after this round'

addressed_weaknesses.weakness: v0 W5: reference narrow and indirect; title overclaims; reusability unclear
addressed_weaknesses.change: New two-line title names the task and the endpoint ('Writing Knowledge-Base Entries from Cited Papers, Scored on Curators' Per-Paper Facts'). Abstract and introduction say curator-written, variant-centred per-paper text and that only what a draft says about each cited paper is scored. Sec. 3.1 adds log 1.1: 327 of 515 cited papers have an in-scope paragraph (81/96 full text, 221/345 abstract, 25/74 title); what a draft says about the others is not scored. 'Reuse' paragraph: fact lists not redistributed, rebuilding requires re-splitting, fresh-split stability unmeasured, per-draft splitting ran 2-5 points higher with the same order, differences within one split are comparable. Contribution (1) reworded to a harness releasing drafts, verdicts and scores but not curator text. Limitation (v).
addressed_weaknesses.evidence: log 1.1; log 4.4; log 8 (24% counterpart); notes 'Reuse of the benchmark', 'Scope of the reference', 'Title'

addressed_weaknesses.weakness: v0 W6: fragile inference and selection (case-table p=0.071, post hoc -8.4 restriction, stop-driven selection, no ITT for completeness arms)
addressed_weaknesses.change: Case-table deficit called suggestive with the sign test, the missing adjustment and the zero-filled interval; the -8.4 restriction labelled post hoc and no longer called 'the stronger evidence'. New 'Status of each analysis' paragraph lists every choice made after results were seen. Post hoc stopped-revision sensitivity (log 15.1) in Sec. 4.3: kept draft +3.1 (+1.8 to +4.3; 32/7/2) and +2.4; zero -4.8 and -3.5 with intervals including zero; gain depends on keeping the unrevised draft (also in introduction). Limitation (ii): the safety filter removed entries unevenly, reasons not visible. Appendix notes that the 3 entries the completeness pass lost are the 3 on which the evidence graph lost a paper.
addressed_weaknesses.evidence: log 2.3a, 2.4, 2.10a, 2.1, 15, 15.1; notes 'The case table's deficit', 'Stopped entries in the reading-better arms'

addressed_weaknesses.weakness: v0 W7: strategies developed on evaluation entries; memorisation confound
addressed_weaknesses.change: Definitions say what each held-out set is held out from (2026 entries: all development; reading-better split: prompt design and guide learning, not the main strategies). Limitation (ix). Memory paragraph gives memory-only coverage by band, the 2026 entries (five strategies, 20 of 30 compared), header-only gene F1 by band (88.9-100% vs 41.2%), the exploratory decline of abstract-only coverage (49.8% to 37.9%), and the oldest band's 34.9% as observed and not analysed. Provenance: 24 of 1,420 (1.7%) in full and 58 of 583 (10.0%) in part stated in no supplied text, post hoc, not separable into recall, inference or misjudgement.
addressed_weaknesses.evidence: log 2.10, 2.11, 3.1, 10; notes '2026 entries', 'Held-out', 'Patterns the log shows but does not explain'

actions_taken: Wrote a new main text from draft_v0 (reusing refined_v1 wording that the v1 reviews did not fault) and attached the refined_v1 appendix, then edited the appendix.

Title shortened to two lines naming task and endpoint; abstract rewritten to 199 words with the hidden-full-text result, the scoped strategy claim, the completeness-pass gain with draft length, and the audit and validation limits; no matched-ablation, equivalence or 'without lowering' wording.

Introduction: released systems and the matched evidence graph removed; findings scoped to the main settings and to entry sets; completeness gain given with draft length and dependence on the stopped-revision rule.

Sec. 3: reference scope from log 1.1; Reuse paragraph; main-comparison extraction effort and rule-based synopsis terms stated in the main text; Definitions paragraph; Status-of-analysis paragraph listing every choice made after results were seen.

Sec. 4.1: hidden-full-text experiment first, like for like before repair (+43.7, +38.3 to +49.1; 45/0/1), with the 49/91/5 paper accounting; cross-paper access levels called observational; stated/not-stated split labelled post hoc and partly by construction.

Sec. 4.2: Table 1 main comparison only, with an audited-claims-per-entry column; case table 'suggestive'; post hoc 'Settings and entry sets' paragraph; recall-then-verify framed as memory-first verified variant; header gene F1 and oldest-band pattern reported as observed.
Sec. 4.3: pre-specified first three arms vs post hoc fourth arm; draft length beside each gain; fidelity 'did not fall on the 20 audited entries (no interval)'; post hoc stopped-revision sensitivity.
Sec. 4.4: runs on 10 or fewer entries reduced to one sentence each.
Sec. 4.5: negation counted as a rule of the deleted-qualifier class, with the widened-rule caveat; Figure 4 caption rewritten accordingly (figure file unchanged).

Sec. 5: discussion of the regime; limitations ordered (human validation, second model family, large inputs, recall-only endpoint, ...) each with what the missing check would establish; conclusion folded into Sec. 5 as a run-in paragraph to fit the page limit.

Appendix: status labels renamed to pre-specified / post hoc / exploratory / secondary; new matched-ablation table with main-settings rows of the same 38 entries; Appendix F paragraph rewritten without duplicate intervals; Appendix G hidden-paper accounting; reading-better design paragraph says what the split is held out from and that the fourth arm is post hoc; released-systems findings paragraph; padding result paragraph (direct reading's rise not read as a gain); every dash in a table explained in its caption; 'added after review' removed everywhere.

Compiled with po.py compile (no errors, no overfull boxes, no undefined references or citations; 54 pages, main text ends on page 10) and ran po.py check (no unknown keys, no missing figures, environments balanced). Figure files and palette unchanged.
